description:
Products from independent Shopify sellers whose price Shoptegrity recorded dropping below its usual level.
    Shows real drops rather than headline discounts, for Black Friday and Cyber Monday. A drop counts only
    with at least 7 earlier days of recorded prices; prices raised before a sale never qualify. min_percent_off
    is 1-90. query filters by words in the title or seller. max_per_seller (default 3) keeps one seller's sale
    from filling the list. Largest drop first, never ordered by commission.
name: verified_deals
title: Verified price drops
